explanation: Heavy body (m=20, vx=30) slingshots light body (m=0.2) to ~124 speed via elastic body-body collision. At dt=1/30 the light body moves ~3.5-4 units per step, far exceeding thin wall thickness 0.1, so the discrete collision/substep logic steps from x=13.39 (step63) to x=16.96 (step64) straight through wall x in [15,15.1] without registering contact. Smaller dt removes failure, confirming timestep/substep CCD inadequacy at emergent high speeds, not initial-speed violation.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 63 and 64

vision_note: The small red body falls toward the bottom while staying left of the thin vertical wall through step 63, then in step 64 it suddenly reappears on the far opposite side of the wall at the bottom edge. The jump crosses the wall line with no contact, while the larger blue body remains on the left side.
